rule: Now I understand the mechanic: the 5 glyphs are a program, and clicking the blue ball runs it (cursor sweeps glyphs, piece moves). Evidence: (bar,stem)=(B,B)→DOWN, (w,B)→RIGHT, (w,w)→no-op. The plug must drop 5 tiles into the U-socket, so all 5 glyphs should be (B,B).
Board D is now empty and ferry 2 carries the last peg. Now driving ferry 2 back to board C.
